blocks.text: MOSCOW — Russia on Monday sought to downplay reports that a laboratory technician had died of plague, even as President Donald Trump said Washington was closely monitoring the situation and offered US help. Reports on Friday that pneumonic plague had killed a 28-year-old woman named Darya Shipilova, who had been working for the anti-plague institute in Siberia’s Irkutsk region, sparked alarm. “We’re looking at it very strongly, we just heard about it,” Trump told reporters at the White House when asked what Washington was going to do about the risk of plague coming from Russia.
